notes.title: Get Surfers Code for free - just for playing the game itself
notes.notes:
A new surf game is coming out this summer of 2024 - Surfers Code.
It hasn't been posted yet and is not available to the public.
You are invited to a preview play, and for your participation you will get a Steam key to the new release with all the future updates and released version when the final version releases.

To play it click this link [url=https://us14.list-manage.com/survey?u=451f838da06d16cb929c0151b&id=a6ab7c9996&attribution=false]Sign Up[/url]

What this means is, all you have to do is play the game, like you would anyway, and you get it for free.

Sound like a good deal?

Here's the catch...
The game will be changed based on how it is being played in these pre-released versions. 
Your progress is not guaranteed to be saved.
You will need a microphone and be okay with having voice and game play recorded. It will not be shared and is only used to make improvements to the game.
Only a limited number of players will be accepted as pre release players.

Here is a Short Explanation what Surfers Code is about . . . 
Take everything good from Search For Surf, add more story, character interaction, improve the graphics, improve the animation, add more places to explore, more breaks to find and you get an immersive surf game with the chill feeling of a tropical surf trip.

Take a boat to nearby breaks, learn about the islands from the characters. Win a jet ski in a contest, and explore the outer islands. 

more on discord here. . . https://discord.gg/7Qe365ZXNz

Try it. You won't be disappointed.

notes.title: Bonus Content For Current Owners
notes.notes:
There have not been updates for a while, and I'm excited to make the new content available. It has been added as a separate button on the store page to sign up for playtesting. Playtesting allows you to load and play the game for as long as it is up on the page. The plan is allow access at least until Summer.

The new updates will be available for PC only, but it's really good, so hopefully you got a good new PC over the holidays.

Development on The Endless Summer Search For Surf has been continuing for many months now, but without updates. 

The Endless Summer "Surfing Challenge", the same one that is on Steam, was also released on the Windows store so you could play it on Xbox.

Recent updates were available through the beta testing option in the game menu, but who knows how to access that? So now new updates will be added as a playtest game. Click on the big button in the store page to sign up and play the new version.

The reason the updates are not automatically added to the current game is because the new version is totally different. New set of islands, new graphics, new features, that could not be easily integrated with the current version. It's like a whole new game.

The new version is a story about a surfer who follows the adventures of The Endless summer crew back to the "fictional" islands that they traveled to during the making of the film.

You will paddle, run, and jump your way through the islands, guided by the lost journal that the film crew left when they originally explored the islands. Find ancient temples, discover new breaks, chat with surfers, and uncover the secrets of this small group of islands with excellent surf breaks, locals, tourists, sharks and other surprises.

As your surfing improves, you will advance through the levels and get rewarded for your abilities.

This is a work in progress and will be updated occasionally. You will see some familiar faces and places. Two player was removed in the hopes of future multiplayer being added. Things will be changed, adjusted, removed, and added, so if you have feedback now is the time to speak up.

Thanks for surfing.

notes.title: A Gentle Surfing Game "The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge"
notes.notes:
The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge is already included in The Endless Summer Search For Surf. No need to buy it if you already have Search For Surf.
The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge has 12 single player challenge rounds and two player contest.
Learn to surf, complete the challenges, try all the players and the POV camera and have two player contests with a friend.

notes.title: If you don't have a problem with the game then no need to update
notes.notes: Some computers were experiencing a black screen on start. Game running but with a screen all black except the UI. This is a new build of the same game. If you don't have the problem then there is no need to update.

notes.title: More Realistic Action
notes.notes:
Updated the surfer movement to be more realistic. Now arms will move with the body to do turns and carves. 

The players are no longer shiny. I know, they're in the water so they should look wet, but instead now they have a more realistic look to them. Let me know if you like it.

The board trims. As you surf across a wave your board would turn flat to the wave with no control. Now you board will adjust so it's flat to the ground when trimming sideways. This is more like real life surfing, and will allow you to cruise more on slow sections, and just in general, especially for tube rides.

Try it post some pics and invite a friend to play. 
You can send an email link to a friend and they can play doubles with you even if they don't have a Steam account or the game.

notes.title: Bug Fixes For Last Recent Big Update
notes.notes:
This is a minor fix to the recent big update.
Game started with controller configured and now starts as a keyboard setup.
Other mostly minor UI button changes.

notes.title: Challenge Levels Added
notes.notes:
Learning to surf has been made easier. If you want to surf better and learn more maneuvers, you can play the challenges. 12 new challenges have been added. From riding time to tube rides, now you can try the increasingly difficult challenges or skip around and try different ones. Want to practice tube riding, go to level 7 and play the same wave until you get it wired. Learn how wave scoring works through practice chat and experimentation. Switch back to the open world and continue your adventure the same as before. 

Two player contests in the challenge rounds uses a new AI camera system that zooms in to the standing player or out to keep both surfers in view. 

There's a new game in town, er I mean on Steam. "[u]The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge[/u]" has been posted as coming soon.

DON'T BUY "[u]The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge[/u]" IF YOU ALREADY HAVE SEARCH FOR SURF!

Please Please Please
[u]DO[/u] PUT "[u]The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge[/u]" ON YOUR WISHLIST!

I know it sounds stupid to put a game on your wishlist that you don't want to buy, but Steam likes wishlists and will favorably promote the game if it gets more wishlists.

Why you should not buy "The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge".... You already own it. The Surfing Challenge game is included in the Search For Surf game.

The Challenges were added to Search For Surf because they are a good way for players that are new to the game, figure out how to surf and catch waves more painlessly than the unstructured open world allows.

Better performance. Do you experience lag when playing? Is you computer just a little too slow to play Search For Surf?
If so, then try the Challenge levels. They were built with consoles and mobile devices in mind. Even if you can't play the open world part of the game, try the challenge levels, and you will likely have better game performance.

notes.title: A Change In The Weather
notes.notes:
There are a couple of new changes that you may notice.  The weather should look a little different with more spectacular sunsets.  The water may look a little more tropical.  There have been some environment tweaks and along with that come some performance improvements.  You may notice some improvement on slower computers especially when playing two player.

Cape St Francis, the perfect wave in The Endless Summer is now what the lighthouse break is called, and there's a nice sign there near the dock to let you know where you are.

BEGINNERS - More Help is Built In...
Helper buttons are on by default.  The main reason for this update was to turn on the helper buttons for beginners.  Helper buttons are the interface on the screen that display to show you which buttons to use and what they do.  They were not turning on by default at the start of the game.  Now they should be on the screen to help, and can be turned off in the menu by pressing esc and going to the buttons option.

New Tutorial - Beginner Tips.  Learn the easiest way to get started easily, and painlessly.  Watch the beginner tips video.  It will show you the basics of surfing, where to be on the wave, how to get speed, how best to use the buttons and to press the Y button, press the Y button, did I mention to press the Y button?  Press the Y button, it makes life much easier.

The esc menu and start screen buttons have been improved and simplified to make that kind of stuff easier to use.

One more thing, change to goofyfoot in the choose a player menu.  The place to change from right foot forward (goofyfoot) to left foot forward (regularfoot) has been changed so you can choose when you select a player.  You may not have even known that this is an option because it was in the gameplay menu along with the help buttons.  Now you can change it when you try a different player.

One more another thing uh...The camera will move when you walk down slopes on land.  Before it would go into the land, but now it will move so you can see where you're going a little better.

Enjoy.  A lot of these changes were made from watching videos of those who posted videos of their game play.  Thanks a lot for posting those videos and keep playing and posting.

notes.title: Real Water Real Spray
notes.notes:
The water spray has been improved to throw realistic spray for schwacks and airs.  Try it and post your new pics.
  
More detailed water sounds bring you into the game.  No you can't smell it, but you can imagine you can smell it.  More realistic effects mean more immersion into the atmosphere.

Play free days continue.  Wishlist on Steam and play when you see the announcements like this one.

Tell your friends. 

If you haven't given it a review, now is a great time to post a review on Steam.
Did I say now?  I meant Right Now.  

Thanks for playing and your suggestions have been really great.
